versions.content: function Read [SWS_DM_02156] Upstream: RS_AP_00114 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00138 virtual ara::core::Future < <ExtendedDataRecordElement>ReadOutput > Read (const ara::diag::MetaInfo &metaInfo, ara::diag::CancellationHandler cancellationHandler) noexcept=0; Provision of a Read ExtendedDataRecordElement. The data fetched by this method is stored in non-volatile memory by the DM and therefore always a value needs to be returned. Not available data at the time of the method call shall be filled with a filling pattern, e.g 0xFF by the implementation of this method (DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordInterface in the role provide).
